chunks: From him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked him about a man who marries a female slave of a people, are the children slaves or free? He said: If one of the parents is free, then the child is free.
ai.seo_question: Are children of a free man and a slave woman considered free or slaves in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Istibsar clarifies the status of offspring in a union between a free man and a slave woman, establishing that freedom is the dominant attribute when at least one parent is free. This principle, known as 'taliq al-walad bi'l-hurr', ensures social mobility and prevents the perpetuation of slavery through maternal lines alone, reflecting the Shia juristic emphasis on the paternal or maternal free status determining the child's legal standing.
